title: The map of the walk, framed
logline: The 2007 walk map — the Sunday that lived on Gully's corkboard — framed, in a house the page doesn't identify, on a wall by a door with a leash on a hook beneath it. Who framed it: reserved. The page draws the leash.

panels.composition: A hand-drawn map of a small town's walking route in a plain frame on a wall beside a door, a dog's leash on a hook beneath it, boots on a mat, the door's window showing rain.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a framed hand-drawn watercolor map of a small coastal town's walking route on a wall beside a door with a dog's leash hanging from a hook beneath it and boots on a mat, rain in the door's window, no words legible
image.notes: The 2007 walk map (dw_2007-05-13). Whose house: reserved.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The walk map, in someone's house. The leash.
